package.name: landmark_geometry
package.description: Single source of truth for the OP3 soccer-field landmark geometry: the field landmark map (L/T/X junctions, goalposts, center circle) and the pinhole camera model with forward projection (world->pixel) and inverse unprojection (pixel->ground z=0). Imported by BOTH the offline label generator (landmark_dataset_gen) and the runtime localization backend so the projection used to label the data is byte-for-byte the projection used at inference. Do NOT create a second camera-projection implementation.
